title: Listening Drill — Park footfall survey
description: Fieldwork briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Park footfall survey
sections.transcript:
LEADER: Let me explain how we'll collect data about how people use the park. Each pair will have the same instructions. That matters because another group needs to be able to repeat what you've done.

LEADER: Start with the main gate. Record the first reading at nine. The quantity we're comparing is visitor numbers. Use the hand counter marked with blue tape.

LEADER: At the end, compare the totals with the other group. If you miss a reading, mark it as missing. Don't fill in a number by copying the nearest result.
